 [@Slp (Crl.) No.8802/2025]
 Bhagti Prasad Mandal Ap
 Versus
 State Of Jharkhand Re
 O R D E R
1. Leave granted.

2. The appellant has been arraigned as an accused in FIR No. 19 of 2025 register with Police Station Bokaro Thermal for offences punishable under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
3.The gist of the complaint is that the appellant is a retired employee of Central Coal Limited (CCL)
who fraudulently obtained a loan for Rs.19,79,000/- (Rupees Nineteen Lakhs Seventy Nine Thousand) from State Bank of India, Bokaro Brnach by submitting forged Aadhar, PAN and Identity Card and also altering his service records.

entities.text: State Bank of India, Bokaro Brnach
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: It is further alleged that the appellant-accused had opened a saving bank account in Punjab National Bank wherein he transferred the post retirement benefits.
4. This Court while ordering notice on 13.06.2025 had granted interim protection from any coercive steps been taken against the appellant.
The amount borrowed is said to have been recovered by the Bank.
5. Be that as it may.

The fact that the appellant had been granted an interim protection and his subsequent conduct of appearing before the investigating officer for the investigation, would suffice to make the interim order absolute.
Accordingly, interim order dated 13.06.2025 is made absolute.
